terms.etiology_clue: The primary source of odontogenic epithelial rests; linked to OKC, dentigerous cyst, and lateral periodontal cyst.
inner enamel epithelium, outer enamel epithelium, stellate reticulum, stratum intermedium
Contribute to surface epithelium-derived odontogenic lesions; relevant to basaloid variants of ameloblastoma and OKC
Post-crown formation remnant; associated with dentigerous cyst and, potentially, unicystic ameloblastoma
Gives rise to odontoblasts and dental pulp; linked to odontogenic fibroma, odontogenic myxoma, and the mesenchymal component of ameloblastic fibroma/fibro-odontoma
Directs root morphogenesis; linked to calcifying epithelial odontogenic tumour (CEOT / Pindborg tumour) and AOT
Remnants of HERS in the periodontal ligament; source of radicular/periapical cysts and potentially some AOTs
Persist in the gingiva after tooth formation; implicated in gingival cysts of adults and lateral periodontal cysts
Gives rise to cementum, PDL, and alveolar bone; source of dentigerous cyst wall, peripheral odontogenic fibroma, and cementoblastoma precursors
Dentine-secreting cells of dental papilla origin; implicated in dentinogenic ghost cell tumour (DGCT) and the dentinoid component of complex/compound odontomas
Inductive interactions at this interface underlie: ameloblastic fibroma, ameloblastic fibro-odontoma, compound/complex odontoma, and DGCT
(aberrant keratinization of odontogenic epithelium) Characteristic of calcifying cystic odontogenic tumour (CCOT / Gorlin cyst) and DGCT
formation requires a healthy, two-way signaling interaction between epithelial cells (which resemble ameloblasts) and the mesenchymal cells (which resemble the dental papilla)
a collagenous, extracellular matrix that resembles dentin
a cementum-like mineralized tissue commonly found in tumors of mesenchymal (ectomesenchymal) origin
misfolded or aggregated enamel matrix proteins
